'''2010 Dagobah Regionals''' was a Players Committee regional, 25–26 July 2010, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Legacy Open]]). The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDF ([[:File:2010 Dagobah Regionals.pdf]]). The PDF on res.starwarsccg.org is cut off after its 13th of 22 pages, so only the decks on those pages are here.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' 25–26 July 2010
* '''Winner:''' —
